use_case: AI document capture and tariff classification suggestions in the customs platform (SYS-01): fills draft entry lines from uploaded invoices and suggests a 10-digit tariff number with a confidence label and generated rationale
vendor_or_model: Customs platform vendor (built-in machine learning capture and generative suggestion feature; model provider not disclosed; feature not covered by the vendor's SOC 2 report)
build_or_buy: Buy (built-in feature, switched on by the vendor in 2026-04 without opt-in)
data_categories: Commercial invoices and packing lists (client records under 19 CFR 111.24): client and supplier names and addresses, products, prices; no importer identification numbers per the vendor
affects_individuals: Yes (about 25 individual importers among about 150 importer clients; duty owed depends on the classification)
human_in_the_loop: Broker approval required before transmission for lines without a product-library match and for every line on a non-English invoice, with the basis recorded in the shipment file; Entry Writers check captured fields on every line; automatic acceptance setting off
applicable_laws: 19 CFR 111.24 (written client authorization for the vendor and model provider); 111.28(a)(1), (2), (5), (8) (responsible supervision and control); 111.29(a) and 111.39(b)-(c) (due diligence; advise clients of errors); 111.21(a) and 111.23(a) (records; originals in the U.S.); 111.21(b) (72-hour CBP notice if a breach occurs); N48-49-R05 CTPAT client questionnaire (indirect)
status: Approved with conditions (2026-08-31): broker approval setting by 2026-09-15; look-back corrections by 2026-09-30; vendor terms by 2026-12-31; reassess 2027-02

use_case: Public generative AI chatbots used by staff for product description research and translation
vendor_or_model: Various free consumer chatbots (consumer terms; chats may be kept and used for training)
data_categories: Intended: general text with no client information. Found in interviews: invoice text pasted by 2 staff in the past 3 months
affects_individuals: Potentially (client and supplier names if invoice text is pasted)
risk_tier: Low for permitted use; client data prohibited
human_in_the_loop: Staff member reads and checks any output; never a basis for a classification
applicable_laws: 19 CFR 111.24 (no client authorization for chatbot vendors, so client records must not be entered)
status: Restricted: client data prohibited (POL-02 C.2; POL-04 4.6); sites blocked on company computers if misuse continues (R-013)

vendor_or_model: Productivity suite vendor's AI assistant add-on
data_categories: Would reach all mail and the Client Records Archive if enabled
applicable_laws: 19 CFR 111.24; Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) (archive holds Social Security numbers of individual importers)
